routes: sea: Prado cove, Marseille to Versova beach (simplified cable route)
what: Ground and sea heights in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid (the height system of Google's 3D map), measured on Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles with Cesium sampleHeightMostDetailed.
layout: r1a/r1b: first/last 1.6 km of the first road, one value every 50 m (r1b counts back from the end). r2a/r2b: the same for the courier's road. sea0/sea1: the water surface where the ship leaves and arrives.
